files.title: File:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge Mitchell Co KS arch detail south side.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption: The arch stones are smooth faced and each has a rusticated keystone. The stones are relatively smooth finished on the underside of each barrel. Some tool marks are present.
files.category: Category:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge

files.title: File:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge Mitchell Co KS northwest side.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption: It is not known exactly when this bridge was constructed, but based on its appearance in comparison with known examples it was likely constructed between 1936 and 1941 by the WPA.
files.category: Category:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge

files.title: File:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge Mitchell Co KS view from creek bed.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption: This is an image of a place or building that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places in the United States of America. Its reference number is 14000439 (Wikidata).
files.category: Category:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge

files.title: File:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge Mitchell Co KS.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption: The foundation is also of stone construction. Based on previous experience with the demolition of other similar bridges, it is estimated that the foundation extends three to four feet under the surface.
files.category: Category:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge

files.title: File:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge Mitchell Co north side KS.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption: The North Rock Creek Bridge is a double stone arch structure that spans North Rock Creek. It is located on an east-west rural secondary road (V Road), just east of 190th Road.
files.category: Category:North Rock Creek Masonry Arch Bridge
